description: PBI AI Agent: Intelligent Data Analysis for Power BI Transform your Power BI reports into interactive AI-powered data analysis experiences. Ask natural language questions about your data and receive instant insights, trends, and visualizations powered by leading AI models including Claude Opus / Sonnet, GPT-5.2, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Grok 4.1 Fast and others. Description of the Offer PBI AI Agent is a custom Power BI visual that integrates advanced AI capabilities directly into your dashboards and reports. Users can interact with their data through natural language conversations, generate instant charts, and receive comprehensive analytical insights without technical expertise. The visual supports multiple AI models, features persistent chat history, interactive chart generation, and professional theming that integrates seamlessly with Power BI environments. Type of User That Benefits Both technical and non-technical users who want to quickly get insights, detect anomalies, and understand data patterns without spending time on manual analysis. Perfect for anyone who needs instant answers from their data regardless of their technical skill level.
